simple.meaning: מַחְלִי (Machlîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Machlite or (collectively) descendants of Machli.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַחְלִי (H4250) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 3:33, with occurrences in Numbers.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַחְלִי (H4250) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַחְלִי (Machlîy) / H4250 is traced through Numbers 3:33, Numbers 26:58 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Machlite or (collectively) descendants of Machli
definitions.full: H4250. Machli II. מַחְלִי adjective, of a people of above; only with article as collective ׳הַמ Num 3:33 ; 26:58 . מַחֲלֻיִים see [ מַחֲלוּי ] below I. חלה . [ מַחֲלָף ], [ מַחֲלָפָה ] see חלף . מַחֲלָצוֺת see [ מַחֲלָצָה ] below I. הלץ . II. מַחְלְקוֺת see II. חלק . מַחֲלֹ֫קֶת see I. חלק . I. מַחֲלַת see below II. חלה .

occurrences.englishText: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
